plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24438
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24463
Merge: #24438 (Japan Times) and #24463 (NHK World) describe the same Adventure, Inc. / skyticket disclosure of October 9, 2026; one record. #24439 (same Japan Times article, titled H.I.S.) is coded separately as the H.I.S. Thai-subsidiary breach, and #24440 (Temairazu) is a separate company and incident.
Scope: Adventure disclosed three unauthorized-access events together (ITmedia @IT, Oct 13): (1) Oct 2-4, 2026, attackers manipulated some skyticket administrative functions and from there reached data on other servers and in cloud storage, ~14.64M customer records (names incl. romanized, DOB, email, phone, address, transfer names), ~4.13M with hashed member passwords; discovered Oct 5. (2) Sept 20, 2026, a vulnerability in the business management system was exploited; 17,780 records (with duplicates) incl. names, phones and refund bank account details; discovered Sept 28. (3) Aug 3 - Oct 1, 2026, bus booking-completion pages were viewable without login and were accessed automatically by third parties; ~12,000 bookings. Coded as one record because the company disclosed them as one incident; reviewer may prefer to split (different vectors and dates; no source says the same actor was behind all three).
Template Hacking-ext-unknown deviations: hacking variety coded from sources instead of Unknown - Abuse of functionality (admin functions manipulated, route 1), Exploit vuln (business management system, route 2; vulnerability not named), Forced browsing (unauthenticated booking pages harvested, route 3). Result Infiltrate only: sources say data 'may have been' leaked/viewed; no explicit exfiltration statement. data_disclosure Yes because unauthorized access to the data stores is confirmed.
Data: Personal 14,640,000 (Japan Times/issue figure; NHK says 14.6M, ITmedia Business 14.67M); Credentials 4,130,000 hashed passwords; Bank 17,780 refund account records. data_total 14,640,000 (overlap between the three sets not disclosed). Card numbers held by a payment processor, not leaked; passport numbers not leaked. Assets: S - Web application plus S - Unknown (other servers; type not stated); cloud External Cloud Asset(s) because cloud storage is named (hosting of the servers themselves not stated).
One member account was logged into without authorization (linked to route 2); no other misuse confirmed, so data_abuse not coded.
Timeline: incident begin Aug 3, 2026 (earliest of the three routes); main route discovered Oct 5 (~2 months after begin). Discovery method not stated -> unknown. dbir_year 2027.
Actor External, variety/motive/country Unknown (no actor or demand reported).
NAICS: #24463 body gave 561520 (Tour Operators) and #24438 gave 5615; changed to 561510 (Travel Agencies) because skyticket is an online travel agency/booking site.
Employee count 101 to 1000 is approximate (Adventure, Inc., TSE 6030, consolidated headcount in the low hundreds); unverified - reviewer please confirm.
Sources: Japan Times and NHK links were not accessible (not read directly); facts taken from the issue bodies, ITmedia @IT (Oct 13, 2026) and ITmedia Business (Oct 31, 2026).
Confidence Medium: action/asset/attribute are sourced but actor is unknown and the three events may be separate incidents.

event_chain.summary: Forced browsing of unauthenticated bus booking pages
Customer data accessed on servers and cloud storage

summary: Adventure, Inc., operator of the Japanese online travel booking site skyticket, disclosed on October 9, 2026 three unauthorized-access incidents: attackers manipulated skyticket administrative functions on October 2-4 and reached data on other servers and cloud storage (about 14.64 million customer records, about 4.13 million with hashed passwords); a vulnerability in the business management system was exploited on September 20 (17,780 records including refund bank account details); and bus booking-completion pages were viewable without login and harvested automatically from August 3 to October 1 (about 12,000 bookings). Card numbers and passport numbers were not leaked.
